selection_rule: Purposive, predeclared 16-name panel spanning eight therapeutic areas. Resolve unique exact canonical names or exact synonyms in the pinned Disease table. Include all cases passing the declared label and Target checks; never consult ranks, z-scores or recall for selection. No replacement for a failed case.
label_rule: Exact Disease-ID clinical_indication membership joined through clinicalReportIds to clinical_report. Require indication maxClinicalStage=APPROVAL and at least one linked FDA, EMA Human Drugs, PMDA or DailyMed report at clinicalStage=APPROVAL and type=INDICATION, with exact Disease and original drug membership and an HTTP(S) source URL. Reject pairs with a linked regulator WITHDRAWAL report. Preserve all qualifying original drug IDs, source reports and eligibility outcomes; never derive labels from Stream A approval.disease_ids or scores.
